jeohunter-3d-dual.description: Part Number:10000609 | Part Number:10000609 | Jeohunter 3D Dual Systemis designed and manufactured using the latest technologies. This system is the World’s most advanced detector for locating precious metals and detecting hidden cavities. Jeohunter 3D Dual System is a deep penetrating detector. The system uses advanced discrimination to accurately classify metal targets in to four groups: Gold, Non-ferrous, Steel and Iron. In addition to accurately detecting and analyzing metal objects, Jeohunter 3D Dual System is also capable of detecting cavities underground like caves, cellars, tunnels, shelters and graves in real time. Jeohunter 3D Dual System is the most advanced graphical imaging system, capable of drawing 2D signal graphs of detected targets in real time. The multifunctional search and detection features allow the user to search comfortably even in very highly mineralized ground conditions. Professional and amateur users alike will appreciate the friendly user interface. Unlike other detectors, Jeohunter 3D Dual System features easy to understand search screens. Jeohunter 3D Dual System provides a complete analysis of the buried target before you dig. The system provides exceptional depth, perfect metal discrimination and an accurate analysis of the target depth and size. Jeohunter 3D Dual System displays the depth of the target to the user in centimeters for both large and small targets. jeohunter3d-dual.description: Part Number:10000609 | Part Number:10000609 | Jeohunter 3D Dual Systemis designed and manufactured using the latest technologies. This system is the World’s most advanced detector for locating precious metals and detecting hidden cavities. Jeohunter 3D Dual System is a deep penetrating detector. The system uses advanced discrimination to accurately classify metal targets in to four groups: Gold, Non-ferrous, Steel and Iron. In addition to accurately detecting and analyzing metal objects, Jeohunter 3D Dual System is also capable of detecting cavities underground like caves, cellars, tunnels, shelters and graves in real time. Jeohunter 3D Dual System is the most advanced graphical imaging system, capable of drawing 2D signal graphs of detected targets in real time. The multifunctional search and detection features allow the user to search comfortably even in very highly mineralized ground conditions. Professional and amateur users alike will appreciate the friendly user interface. Unlike other detectors, Jeohunter 3D Dual System features easy to understand search screens. Jeohunter 3D Dual System provides a complete analysis of the buried target before you dig. The system provides exceptional depth, perfect metal discrimination and an accurate analysis of the target depth and size. Jeohunter 3D Dual System displays the depth of the target to the user in centimeters for both large and small targets. The system provides this same depth analysis for both metal targets and cavities

the-legend-2.description: Part Number:11000562 | Part Number:11000562 | With smarter software, enhanced power, and unmatched precision, The LEGEND 2 sets a new standard in simultaneous multi-frequency detection.An expanded 99 Target IDs, improved audio clarity with 7 tone options, and a redesigned user interface and button layout give you faster, sharper control in every hunt. The upgraded battery provides up to 33% more runtime, while wireless update capability and compatibility with low-latency Bluetooth, and bone-conduction headphones keep you ready for the future.
